events.text: Pia: I’m in, but I’m a little worried about the logistics—what time are we starting, and where should people drop things off?
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: we’ll start at 9 a.m. by the community shed, and folks can drop items off there until noon. I’ll put up a clear sign so nobody has to guess.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Pia: That works for me—thank you. I’ll tell people to aim for the shed by 9 and to get their drop-offs in before noon.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Jules: Thanks, Eli — I’m lining up the repair tasks around the school pickup window and the tools Gus is bringing. If you’re free, I could use one more set of hands when the drive starts.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Eli: I can help with that. I’ll be there at 9 by the community shed and can lend a hand as long as we keep the plan simple.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Jules: Perfect, Eli — 9 by the community shed works great. I’ll keep it simple and make sure you know the first task when you arrive.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Eli: Sounds good — I’ll bring a clear sign to the shed and keep the setup simple. If anything changes, I’ll let you know right away.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Pia: Thanks, Eli — that should help a lot. I’ll pass along the shed at 9 a.m. and the noon cutoff so everyone knows where to go.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Eli: Great — that should keep things smooth. I’ll be at the shed by 9 with the sign.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Eli: Sounds good — I’ll be at the community shed at 9 and keep things straightforward. If anything changes, I’ll let you know right away.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Tess: Perfect, I’ll pass that along — community shed at 9. If anything shifts, I’ll let everyone know right away.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Eli: Great — I’ll be there at 9 and keep to the plan. Thanks for passing it along.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and check with folks on my street and the next couple blocks. If you want, I can bring back a quick list of who can help.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Eli: Thanks, Quinn — that’d be helpful. I’ll be at the community shed by 9 with the sign, and we can keep it simple.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Quinn: Sounds good — I’ll start talking it up right away and bring you a quick list of folks who can help by the shed.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Eli: I’ll be at the community shed by 9 with the sign, and we can keep the drop-off area simple. If anything shifts, I’ll let you know right away.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll bring the hammer, screwdrivers, and extra gloves. Just let me know if anything changes.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Eli: Thanks, Leo — that should cover it nicely. I’ll keep the setup simple at the shed and let you know right away if anything changes.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Eli: Sounds good — I’ll be at the community shed at 9 with the sign. If anything changes, I’ll let you know right away.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Nell: Thanks — I’ve only been hearing bits and pieces, so I’ll keep an ear out and pass along anything I hear.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Eli: Thanks, Nell — that’d be helpful. I’ll keep the plan simple and stick with the shed at 9.
events.speaker: Eli
